description: Regimens of the engine with reference rates from the literature. severe_toxicity_rate is the share of patients with at least one adverse event of grade 3 or higher. ild_rate is the share with drug-related interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis; null means that the sources give no rate and the engine generates none.

nalirifox.source: Wainberg et al. (2023), NAPOLI 3, grade 3 or higher treatment-emergent adverse events

gemcitabine_nab_paclitaxel.source: Wainberg et al. (2023), NAPOLI 3, grade 3 or higher treatment-emergent adverse events

adt_docetaxel.source: Smith et al. (2022), ARASENS, placebo arm, grade 3 or 4 adverse events

adt_docetaxel_abiraterone.source: Fizazi et al. (2022), PEACE-1, grade 3 or worse adverse events

adt_docetaxel_darolutamide.source: Smith et al. (2022), ARASENS, grade 3 or 4 adverse events

lu_psma_617.source: Sartor et al. (2021), VISION, grade 3 or higher adverse events

olaparib.source: de Bono et al. (2020), PROfound, grade 3 or higher adverse events

trastuzumab_deruxtecan.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04, grade 3 or higher adverse events and adjudicated drug-related interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis

chemotherapy_single_agent.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04, physician's choice arm

pembrolizumab_chemotherapy.source: Cortes et al. (2022), KEYNOTE-355, treatment-related adverse events of grade 3 to 5
